about.heading: Who I Am
about.intro: I am an AI Engineer specializing in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (B.Tech, 2026), dedicated to building production-ready, intelligent systems. My expertise spans the complete machine learning lifecycle—from data engineering and model optimization to deploying generative AI, RAG pipelines, and computer vision solutions using lightweight frameworks like FastAPI and Flask. Guided by technical curiosity, I focus on turning complex algorithmic concepts into robust, user-centric automation tools.

cards.title: My Mission
cards.text: To engineer high-impact, AI-driven solutions that bridge the gap between advanced research and practical utility. I aim to build systems that are not just theoretically sound, but pragmatically designed to solve real-world problems, optimize workflows, and drive measurable value.

cards.title: My Vision
cards.text: To help pioneer the next generation of intelligent, ethical, and accessible agentic systems. As an aspiring leader in the AI space, I am committed to continuous learning, building with integrity, and expanding the boundaries of what human-AI collaboration can achieve.
